patterns.message: main uses the features only through the manifest.
core never uses a feature, the manifest or main. The composition connects them.
The manifest uses only the presentation (the registration) of each feature.
A feature never uses core, main or the manifest. The composition gives it the services of core through the contracts of shared.
A feature uses a different feature only through its facade ({feature}.api.ts).
A feature never uses core, main or the manifest. The composition gives it the services of core through the contracts of shared.
A feature uses a different feature only through its facade ({feature}.api.ts).
presentation never uses data: only the registration (routes) creates it for logic. The direction is presentation → logic → data.
A feature never uses core, main or the manifest. The composition gives it the services of core through the contracts of shared.
A feature uses a different feature only through its facade ({feature}.api.ts).
The facade never uses presentation or data. The direction is facade → logic → data.
A feature never uses core, main or the manifest. The composition gives it the services of core through the contracts of shared.
A feature uses a different feature only through its facade ({feature}.api.ts).
logic never uses presentation or the facade. The direction is presentation → logic → data.
A feature never uses core, main or the manifest. The composition gives it the services of core through the contracts of shared.
A feature uses a different feature only through its facade ({feature}.api.ts).
data never uses presentation, logic or the facade. The direction is presentation → logic → data.
shared uses no part of the application: no core, features or main.
